name: Task Definition
description: Versioned, immutable JSON manifest describing how a task is built. Identified by family + revision (e.g., my-app:7). Bundles container definitions, volumes, network mode, IAM roles, runtime platform, capacity requirements. RegisterTaskDefinition creates a new revision; previous revisions remain referenceable.

name: Task family + revision
description: family is the logical name (a string); revision is an auto-incremented integer per family (1, 2, 3…). Services pin to either family:revision (immutable) or family alone (latest ACTIVE revision). Deregistered revisions enter INACTIVE but stay queryable.

name: Container Definition
description: Per-container spec inside a task: name, image, resources, env, ports, mounts, logging, health, security. A task can have 1-10 container definitions; the first essential container's exit terminates the task.

name: essential flag (sidecar semantics)
description: Per-container: essential=true means task stops when this container exits; essential=false (sidecar pattern) means container exit doesn't stop the task. At least one container must be essential. Common usage: app=essential, log-router/proxy=non-essential.

name: Task network modes (awsvpc/bridge/host/none)
description: awsvpc: per-task ENI with own IP+SG (Fargate REQUIRES this; EC2 supports). bridge: shared docker0 bridge (EC2 default; uses port-mappings). host: shares host network namespace (no isolation; highest perf). none: no networking. Choice constrains IAM-for-tasks behavior + service-discovery + port-conflict semantics.

name: taskRoleArn vs executionRoleArn
description: executionRoleArn: agent's perms to RUN the task (pull from ECR, write to CloudWatch Logs, fetch Secrets/SSM, attach EFS). taskRoleArn: container's runtime perms (the AWS APIs the app code calls). These MUST be separate — execution role is infrastructure; task role is application.

name: requiresCompatibilities
description: Pre-flight validator: FARGATE, EC2, EXTERNAL (ECS Anywhere). Validates the task def against the launch type's restrictions (e.g., FARGATE forbids privileged containers, requires awsvpc). Caller exception if mismatch.

name: Fargate CPU/memory matrix
description: Fargate restricts task-level cpu+memory to discrete combinations: 256/.25vCPU → 512MiB/1GB/2GB; 512 → 1-4GB; 1024 → 2-8GB; 2048 → 4-16GB (1GB steps); 4096 → 8-30GB; 8192 → 16-60GB (4GB steps, Linux platform 1.4.0+); 16384 → 32-120GB (8GB steps, Linux 1.4.0+). Mismatched combos fail at RegisterTaskDefinition.

name: ephemeralStorage (Fargate)
description: Fargate-only. Per-task scratch disk size in GiB, range 21-200 (default 20). Mounted into all containers. EC2 launch type uses host disk + dockerPathOnHost without this field.

name: runtimePlatform (OS family + CPU arch)
description: Combines operatingSystemFamily (LINUX, WINDOWS_SERVER_2019_FULL/CORE, WINDOWS_SERVER_2022_FULL/CORE, WINDOWS_SERVER_2025_FULL/CORE) + cpuArchitecture (X86_64, ARM64). Required on Fargate. Service.platformFamily must match for service-managed tasks.

name: Volume types (host, efsVolumeConfiguration, fsxWindowsFileServer, dockerVolumeConfiguration, configuredAtLaunch)
description: Task-level volumes attached to one or more containers via mountPoints. Types: host (host bind-mount), dockerVolumeConfiguration (named Docker volume), efsVolumeConfiguration (EFS network mount), fsxWindowsFileServerVolumeConfiguration (FSx for Windows), configuredAtLaunch (EBS attach, Fargate platform 1.4+).

name: mountPoint (volume → container binding)
description: Per-container array of {sourceVolume, containerPath, readOnly}. Binds a task-level volume into a specific in-container path. sourceVolume must match a name in task-level volumes[].

name: Container dependsOn (ordering)
description: Per-container array of {containerName, condition}. Conditions: START (depended-on container started), COMPLETE (exited 0), SUCCESS (exited 0 — alias), HEALTHY (passed healthCheck). Lets you express init-container patterns + sidecar startup ordering.

name: Container healthCheck
description: Per-container Docker HEALTHCHECK semantics: command (CMD-SHELL or CMD list), interval (5-300s, default 30s), timeout (2-60s, default 5s), retries (1-10, default 3), startPeriod (0-300s, grace before failures count). Combined with dependsOn HEALTHY for inter-container ordering.

name: logConfiguration (drivers + options + secrets)
description: Per-container logDriver (awslogs, awsfirelens, splunk, fluentd, gelf, journald, json-file, syslog) + options (driver-specific KV) + secretOptions (driver options sourced from Secrets Manager / SSM). Available drivers gated by ECS_AVAILABLE_LOGGING_DRIVERS on the agent.

name: linuxParameters (capabilities, devices, tmpfs, sharedMemorySize, swappiness)
description: Per-container Linux-specific overrides: capabilities.add[]/.drop[] (ALL, CHOWN, NET_ADMIN, SYS_ADMIN, etc.), devices (host device passthrough), initProcessEnabled (tini PID 1), maxSwap, sharedMemorySize (MB), swappiness, tmpfs[].

name: firelensConfiguration (log routing)
description: Per-container Fluent Bit / Fluentd-based log routing. type=fluentbit|fluentd; options={enable-ecs-log-metadata, config-file-type, config-file-value}. Enables flexible multi-destination log shipping (e.g., CloudWatch + Datadog + S3 from one container).

name: Service Definition
description: Long-lived task-runner. Pins a task definition + desiredCount + launch type + load balancer + service discovery + capacity provider strategy + deployment configuration. Maintains desiredCount of running tasks via task-replacement on failure.
